3 Screens · 200 Luxury Recliner Seats · ConnPlex Franchise (Founded Gujarat, 2019) · Ahmedabad, Gujarat
WHY AHMEDABAD, WHY NOW — MARKET SIGNALS

• ConnPlex is a Gujarat-founded (2019) cinema franchise, already running 33+ screens across the state with 250 more planned — the brand states Gujarat can support 300 additional screens. Source: bilkulonline.com, Dec 2024. • Ahmedabad had 130 movie theatres as of Oct 2025, up 10% since 2023 — including PVR INOX's 9-screen flagship IMAX/LUXE launch at Phoenix Palladium. Source: rentechdigital.com; newsonprojects.com. • India has ~9,500 screens for 1.43bn people (1 per ~147,000) vs the US (1 per 8,000) — the industry sees room for 25,000+ more Indian screens. Source: ConnPlex franchise disclosure, franchiseavs.com. • Gujarati-language box office alone grew from ₹46 cr (2015) to ₹104+ cr (Oct 2025) — 100%+ growth in a decade. Source: articles.uvnetware.com, Jan 2026. • National multiplex ATP: ₹259-262; F&B spend-per-head hit a record ₹148 in Q1 FY26 — both trending up. Source: PVR INOX investor disclosures / ICICI Direct, 2025-26.
HOW MOVIES EARN — RECENT INDIAN BOX-OFFICE BENCHMARKS
A single well-marketed tentpole can fill every recliner in the country for weeks - proof of the demand a great slate creates.
Mid-budget period drama outperforming expectations shows genre diversity, not just star power, drives footfalls.
A modestly-budgeted romance became a sleeper hit - premium recliner formats let smaller films still deliver strong per-screen yields.
Regional-language content is now routinely crossing ₹800cr+ nationally, widening the content pipeline for every screen.
Sources: Bollywood Hungama Box Office Report 2025-26; Wikipedia – List of Hindi films of 2025; Hollywood Reporter India, Feb 2026.

• Area required: 6,000-9,000 sq.ft • Screens: 3 • Seating: Sofa Sliders, Duo Loungers, Recliners • Capacity: up to ~175-260 seats • Franchisor-claimed occupancy: 60%+ • Franchisor-claimed payback: 3-4 years

* Minimum ceiling height: 12 ft (per ConnPlex build specification).
